title: Original Human-approved pre-W01 GOV-REFORM-20261013 9+6+mid-Sprint implementation repair, plus bounded once-per-Task conditional authority

why5.question: Why are users repeatedly asked to approve the same L1 Task?
why5.answer: Current lifecycle mandates Human Final Ready, Merge and Closure as separate actor-bound steps even when scope and Task are unchanged.

why5.question: Why can a simple chat convention not fix this?
why5.answer: The canonical policy and Constitution still define those individual Human-only steps and retain enforceable governance semantics.

why5.question: Why not simply delete Human approval and all gates?
why5.answer: That would allow unbounded scope changes, failed CI, untested Acceptance and forged approvals to move authority. Separate testing and independent BCE must remain.

why5.question: How can one approval stay scoped to the same authorized Task?
why5.answer: Bind the grant to Task/Sprint/Build/BASE/scope digest, Human source and TTL, recheck latest full CI/BCE/AC and merged Main for every step; block any drift.

why5.question: Why separate automation eligibility from authentication and merge execution?
why5.answer: An AI or shared GitHub account cannot cryptographically prove direct Human origin. Only a trusted external executor may establish that fact and perform GitHub writes.

alternatives: Keep three Human interactions per Task: repetitive and rejected for routine unchanged L1.
Auto-merge from any GPT assertion without verified Human source: rejected.
One bounded L1 conditional grant + exact live Gate/BCE/AC proof + trusted executor: selected.
no_change: Existing lifecycle still requires independent Human events and creates repeated interruptions on routine unchanged Task work.
rollback: Human-governed revert of this eight-file L3 amendment only; restore Human-only transition actors and policy; never rewrite closed Sprint or Product truth.

scope_exception.reason: Human 要求落實 2026-10-13 W01 前 Issue #389 原始 16 項治理改革；一般 Task 只有一次真實 Human 條件批准，之後同範圍開發、CI、BCE、Merge、Task Closure 不再重複請批。新增 GitHub Protected Environment 真核准核發與核驗候選，尚未於 Main 生效。
scope_exception.risk: Improper trusted-executor implementation could spoof Human source; fail closed until trust is configured and verified. Repository rule changes remain L3.
scope_exception.owner: Human governance owner; GPT rule candidate/BCE only
scope_exception.follow_up: 本候選須 Human 精確 L3 候選審定、真實 4 Gate/獨立 BCE、受保護 Merge；GitHub Environment Required reviewer 必須真實設定後以一個正常 Task 完成從 PLANNED 核准→Activation→開發→CI→BCE→Merge→Closure 的 E2E，否則不可稱 16 項全面實施。Sprint 3 特批行政結案維持獨立，不能改 T006/T008 的真實缺口。
scope_exception.expires_at_rule: Set only after authentic exact candidate Human decision; max 30 days.
